name: Hurting Children
overview: Scripture affirms that children are a precious heritage from the Lord and a divine reward, emphasizing their inherent value and innocence (Psalms 127:3; Exodus 23:7). God commands just treatment of children, warning severe consequences for those who harm or lead them astray (Matthew 18:6; Deuteronomy 32:35). Parents are called to lovingly discipline and train their children in the ways of righteousness, ensuring their spiritual preservation and growth (Proverbs 19:18; Proverbs 22:6). This underscores the sacred responsibility to protect and nurture children according to God's truth.
